notes: Panels now conjure while they wait. Instead of sitting blank or filling in piece by piece, a panel holds behind a sigil that inscribes itself, then arrives all at once when its readings are in.
The wait is deliberate, not overhead - it is the time the sensors need to report, so the panel can arrive complete instead of growing three times on its way to the right size.

A panel now waits for what it is showing to stop changing before it appears. Previously it decided it was ready when the sensor count held steady, which meant weather arriving a couple of seconds later grew the OG widget from 284 to 924…

The loading state is one shared piece rather than each panel's own. Every panel gets the same conjuring and the same arrival, and a theme restyles all of them by setting a handful of values once - colour, glow, size, and how long the…
